game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Library Tower, the royal library tower: the town guard must handle rogue knights while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against rogue knights.
theme: The Kingdom – Library Tower: the royal library tower
core_gameplay_loop: In Library Tower, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against rogue knights. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the potion value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the town gate using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The town gate reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the town gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 4 (applied tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Library Tower'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue knights in Library Tower.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The town gate reached with actions_used <= 20.
